1	extends Node2D
2	
3	const Player = preload("res://features/player/player.gd")
4	const Hud = preload("res://ui/hud.gd")
5	enum State { MENU, PLAYING, PAUSED, DYING, COMPLETE }
6	var state: State = State.MENU
7	var player: CharacterBody2D
8	var camera: Camera2D
9	var hud: Control
10	var level: Dictionary
11	var hazard_areas: Array[Area2D] = []
12	var goal: Area2D
13	var deaths: int = 0
14	var elapsed: float = 0.0
15	var retry_remaining: float = 0.0
16	var death_reason: String = ""
17	var last_finish_time: float = 0.0
18	var test_mode: bool = false
19	var contact_settle_ticks: int = 0
20	var survivors: Array = []       # [{area, type, rescued, x, y}] — the trapped survivors
21	var rescued_count: int = 0      # how many rescued this attempt
22	var locked_cue_ticks: int = 0   # frames left to flash the "rescue everyone" cue
23	var saved_popup_ticks: int = 0  # frames left to show the "SAVED!" popup
24	var saved_popup_pos: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
25	const EXTINGUISH_TICKS := 240          # 4 s @ 60 Hz for the fire to fully die (half by 2 s)
26	var fire_active: bool = true           # lethal + blocks the rescue until FULLY hosed
27	var extinguish_ticks: int = 0          # frames until the fire is out (240 = full, 0 = out)
28	var water_ticks: int = 0               # frames the water visual keeps pouring (lingers ~1 s)
29	var near_fire: bool = false            # player in hose range this frame (for the prompt)
30	# Rescue toss (visual only): the rescued survivor is grabbed, flung sky-high, and drops into
31	# the bag. Game state (rescued, counts) changes at the touch, before any of this is drawn.
32	const GRAB_TICKS := 15                 # grab pose, survivor held at the window
33	const TOSS_UP_TICKS := 30              # flying up
34	const TOSS_DOWN_TICKS := 30            # dropping into the bag
35	const TOSS_HEIGHT := 150.0
36	var flights: Array = []                # [{type, from: Vector2, t: int, launch, apex}]
37	const FIRE_DEATH_HOLD := 2.0          # s; was 0.55 (A1), 0.9 (playtest 2); 2.0 after playtest 3
38	const BOW_TICKS := 75                  # the bow shows ~1.2 s before the "Rescue complete" card covers him
39	var complete_ticks: int = 0
40	# Audio (CHANGE-BRIEF event-to-sound map). Every sound plays AFTER the state change it reports;
41	# nothing reads a sound or a mute flag, so a missing or muted sound never changes what happens.
42	const SFX_FILES := {"jump": "sfx_jump", "hose": "sfx_hose", "rescue": "sfx_rescue",
43		"burn": "sfx_burn", "win": "sfx_win"}
44	const MUSIC_FILE := "res://audio/music_loop.ogg"
45	const MUSIC_DIP_DB := -12.0            # music level under the burn sound while DYING
46	var sfx_players := {}
47	var sfx_counts := {}                   # plays per sound id (read by tests/test_audio.gd)
48	var sfx_log: Array = []                # [{id, state, tick}] per play, so tests can check the order
49	var music: AudioStreamPlayer
50	const FIRE_SINGLE := preload("res://art/env/fire_single.png")   # ENV-FIRE-A
51	const FIRE_WIDE := preload("res://art/env/fire_wide.png")       # ENV-FIRE-B
52	const FIRE_TALL := preload("res://art/env/fire_tall.png")       # ENV-FIRE-Bb
53	
54	func _ready() -> void:
55		process_physics_priority = 10
56		level = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string("res://levels/first_steps.json"))
57		_setup_input()
58		for entry in level.solids:
59			_add_solid(Rect2(entry[0], entry[1], entry[2], entry[3]))
60		_add_solid(Rect2(-32, 0, 32, 430))
61		_add_solid(Rect2(level.width, 0, 32, 430))
62		for entry in level.hazards:
63			hazard_areas.append(_add_area(Rect2(entry[0], entry[1], entry[2], entry[3]), 8, true))
64		var f: Array = level.finish
65		goal = _add_area(Rect2(f[0], f[1], f[2], f[3]), 16, false)
66		for entry in level.survivors:
67			var area := _add_area(Rect2(entry[0] - 8.0, entry[1] - 22.0, 16.0, 22.0), 32, false)
68			survivors.append({"area": area, "type": String(entry[2]), "rescued": false, "x": float(entry[0]), "y": float(entry[1])})
69		player = Player.new()
70		add_child(player)
71		player.reset_at(Vector2(level.spawn[0], level.spawn[1]))
72		camera = Camera2D.new()
73		camera.position = Vector2(320, 180)
74		add_child(camera)
75		# ENV-BG: the generated skyline, fixed behind everything (a distant backdrop, so it doesn't scroll).
76		var bg_layer := CanvasLayer.new()
77		bg_layer.layer = -1
78		add_child(bg_layer)
79		var bg := TextureRect.new()
80		bg.texture = load("res://art/env/env_bg.png")
81		bg.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
82		bg.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_SCALE
83		bg.size = Vector2(640, 360)
84		bg_layer.add_child(bg)
85		_setup_audio()
86		player.jumped.connect(func(): play_sfx("jump"))
87		var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
88		add_child(layer)
89		hud = Hud.new()
90		hud.game = self
91		layer.add_child(hud)
92		get_window().focus_exited.connect(_on_focus_lost)
93		queue_redraw()
94	
95	func _setup_input() -> void:
96		var actions := {"move_left": [KEY_A, KEY_LEFT], "move_right": [KEY_D, KEY_RIGHT], "jump": [KEY_SPACE], "pause": [KEY_ESCAPE, KEY_P], "restart": [KEY_R], "confirm": [KEY_ENTER], "menu": [KEY_M], "water": [KEY_W], "mute_music": [KEY_N], "mute_sfx": [KEY_B]}
97		for action in actions:
98			if InputMap.has_action(action):
99				continue
100			InputMap.add_action(action)
101			for key in actions[action]:
102				var event := InputEventKey.new()
103				event.physical_keycode = key
104				InputMap.action_add_event(action, event)
105	
106	func _add_solid(rect: Rect2) -> void:
107		var body := StaticBody2D.new()
108		body.position = rect.position + rect.size / 2
109		body.collision_layer = 1
110		body.collision_mask = 2
111		var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
112		shape.size = rect.size
113		var collision := CollisionShape2D.new()
114		collision.shape = shape
115		body.add_child(collision)
116		add_child(body)
117	
118	func _add_area(rect: Rect2, layer: int, spikes: bool) -> Area2D:
119		var area := Area2D.new()
120		area.position = rect.position
121		area.collision_layer = layer
122		area.collision_mask = 2
123		if spikes:
124			# Three exact triangular trigger silhouettes; no oversized invisible box.
125			for i in range(3):
126				var triangle := CollisionPolygon2D.new()
127				var x := float(i) * rect.size.x / 3.0
128				triangle.polygon = PackedVector2Array([Vector2(x, rect.size.y), Vector2(x + 4, 0), Vector2(x + 8, rect.size.y)])
129				area.add_child(triangle)
130		else:
131			var collision := CollisionShape2D.new()
132			var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
133			shape.size = rect.size
134			collision.shape = shape
135			collision.position = rect.size / 2.0
136			area.add_child(collision)
137		add_child(area)
138		return area
139	
140	func start_session() -> void:
141		if state == State.PLAYING:
142			return
143		deaths = 0
144		restart_attempt()
145	
146	func restart_attempt() -> void:
147		state = State.PLAYING
148		elapsed = 0.0
149		retry_remaining = 0.0
150		# Area2D overlaps are physics-step snapshots. Discard pre-teleport contacts
151		# until the broadphase has observed the reset, preventing a phantom second death.
152		contact_settle_ticks = 2
153		player.reset_at(Vector2(level.spawn[0], level.spawn[1]))
154		player.enabled = true
155		camera.position = Vector2(320, 180)
156		rescued_count = 0
157		locked_cue_ticks = 0
158		saved_popup_ticks = 0
159		fire_active = true
160		extinguish_ticks = 0
161		water_ticks = 0
162		flights.clear()
163		for s in survivors:
164			s.rescued = false
165			s.area.set_deferred("monitoring", true)
166	
167	# Blocking-fire height in px: full until hosing starts, then shrinks linearly to 0
168	# over EXTINGUISH_TICKS (half by 2 s). Drives both the flame visual and the kill-zone.
169	func fire_height() -> float:
170		if not fire_active or not level.has("blocking_fire"):
171			return 0.0
172		var full: float = float(level.blocking_fire[3])
173		if extinguish_ticks > 0:
174			return full * float(extinguish_ticks) / float(EXTINGUISH_TICKS)
175		return full
176	
177	func set_paused(value: bool) -> void:
178		if value and state == State.PLAYING:
179			state = State.PAUSED
180			player.enabled = false
181		elif not value and state == State.PAUSED:
182			state = State.PLAYING
183			player.enabled = true
184			player.require_jump_release = true
185			player.jump_request_tick = -1000
186	
187	func _on_focus_lost() -> void:
188		if not test_mode:
189			set_paused(true)
190	
191	func resolve_contacts(fatal: bool, finished: bool) -> void:
192		if state != State.PLAYING:
193			return
194		if fatal:
195			state = State.DYING
196			deaths += 1
197			retry_remaining = 0.55
198			player.enabled = false
199			player.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
200			if death_reason == "The fire got you.":
201				player.show_pose("burned")
202				play_sfx("burn")
203				retry_remaining = FIRE_DEATH_HOLD  # burned pose + DEVASTATED pop-up stay up; R skips the wait
204		elif finished:
205			state = State.COMPLETE
206			last_finish_time = elapsed
207			player.enabled = false
208			player.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
209			player.show_pose("celebrate")
210			complete_ticks = 0
211			play_sfx("win")
212	
213	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
214		if state == State.DYING:
215			retry_remaining -= delta
216			if retry_remaining <= 0:
217				restart_attempt()
218		elif state == State.PLAYING:
219			elapsed += delta
220			var fell := player.position.y > float(level.fall_y)
221			var timed_out := elapsed >= float(level.time_limit)
222			var hit_fire := false
223			for hazard in hazard_areas:
224				if hazard.overlaps_body(player):
225					hit_fire = true
226			# The blocking fire is lethal + blocks the path until FULLY hosed. Its kill-zone
227			# shrinks from the top with the flames (see fire_height), but the base stays lethal
228			# until the fire is completely out -- so walking in mid-extinguish still kills.
229			if fire_active and level.has("blocking_fire"):
230				var bf0: Array = level.blocking_fire
231				var fire_top: float = (float(bf0[1]) + float(bf0[3])) - fire_height()
232				var half_w: float = Player.BOX.x / 2.0
233				if player.position.x + half_w > float(bf0[0]) and player.position.x - half_w < float(bf0[0]) + float(bf0[2]) and player.position.y > fire_top and player.position.y - Player.BOX.y < float(bf0[1]) + float(bf0[3]):
234					hit_fire = true
235			var fatal := fell or timed_out or hit_fire
236			if fatal:
237				death_reason = "Out of time!" if timed_out else ("You fell." if fell else "The fire got you.")
238			# Hose: tap W within range of the blocking fire -> water pours ~4 s -> fire out.
239			near_fire = false
240			if fire_active and level.has("blocking_fire"):
241				var bf: Array = level.blocking_fire
242				near_fire = player.is_on_floor() and player.position.x > float(bf[0]) - 50.0 and player.position.x < float(bf[0]) + float(bf[2]) + 10.0 and player.position.y < float(bf[1]) + float(bf[3]) + 20.0 and player.position.y > float(bf[1]) - 40.0
243				var water: bool = player.test_water_pressed if player.test_control else Input.is_action_just_pressed("water")
244				if player.test_control:
245					player.test_water_pressed = false
246				if water and near_fire and extinguish_ticks == 0:
247					extinguish_ticks = EXTINGUISH_TICKS
248					water_ticks = EXTINGUISH_TICKS + 60  # water lingers ~1 s after it is out
249					play_sfx("hose")
250			if extinguish_ticks > 0:
251				extinguish_ticks -= 1
252				if extinguish_ticks == 0:
253					fire_active = false
254			if water_ticks > 0:
255				water_ticks -= 1
256			player.hosing = water_ticks > 0
257			# Touch to rescue -- only while NOT in a fatal state, so you can't rescue THROUGH fire.
258			if not fatal:
259				for s in survivors:
260					if not s.rescued and s.area.overlaps_body(player):
261						s.rescued = true
262						s.area.set_deferred("monitoring", false)
263						rescued_count += 1
264						player.rescued = rescued_count
265						player.bag_types.append(s.type)
266						player.bag_in_flight += 1
267						player.play_actions([["grab", GRAB_TICKS], ["toss", TOSS_UP_TICKS]])
268						flights.append({"type": s.type, "from": Vector2(s.x, s.y), "t": 0})
269						play_sfx("rescue")
270						saved_popup_ticks = 55
271						saved_popup_pos = Vector2(s.x - 18.0, s.y - 34.0)
272			var all_rescued := rescued_count >= survivors.size()
273			var at_exit := goal.overlaps_body(player) and player.is_on_floor()
274			if at_exit and not all_rescued:
275				locked_cue_ticks = 45  # flash "rescue everyone first"
276			if locked_cue_ticks > 0:
277				locked_cue_ticks -= 1
278			if saved_popup_ticks > 0:
279				saved_popup_ticks -= 1
280			if contact_settle_ticks > 0:
281				contact_settle_ticks -= 1
282			else:
283				# Exit completes only when BOTH survivors are rescued AND reached on foot.
284				# State machine unchanged; only the COMPLETE condition gains "both rescued".

signal jumped  # emitted once per real jump (the session plays SFX-JUMP; sound never feeds back)

const Tuning = preload("res://features/player/tuning.gd")
var tuning = Tuning.new()
var enabled: bool = false
var tick: int = 0
var last_floor_tick: int = -1000
var jump_request_tick: int = -1000
var opportunity_consumed: bool = false
var require_jump_release: bool = true
var facing: float = 1.0
var rescued: int = 0  # survivors in the rescue bag (set by session; used for drawing)
var bag_types: Array = []  # survivor types riding in the bag, e.g. ["person","dog"] (set by session)
var jumps: int = 0
var test_control: bool = false
var test_axis: float = 0.0
var test_jump_pressed: bool = false
var test_jump_held: bool = false
var test_water_pressed: bool = false  # hose input hook for the scripted route / tests
# Extinguisho art: one static generated image per state, swapped in (visual only; never read by gameplay).
const ART_DIR := "res://art/character/"
const BOX := Vector2(20, 40)   # collision box; feet at the origin (CHARACTER-SHEET, collision option A)
const LAND_TICKS := 20         # landing pose holds this long after real air time (was 8: too fast to see)
const NOZZLE := Vector2(33, -27.5)  # hose nozzle tip in the hose pose (game px, facing right): the water starts here
# Rescue bag center per pose (game px, facing right): on his back at the hip, measured on each image.
const BAG := {"idle": Vector2(-10, -30), "respawn": Vector2(-13, -20), "run": Vector2(-8, -21),
	"jump_crouch": Vector2(-9, -30), "rising": Vector2(-10, -18), "falling": Vector2(-12, -16),
	"landing": Vector2(-8, -20), "hose": Vector2(-10, -19), "grab": Vector2(-10, -27),
	"toss": Vector2(-10, -31), "burned": Vector2(-10, -30), "celebrate": Vector2(-9, -27)}
var pose: String = "idle"
var art: Node2D
var sprite: Sprite2D
var textures := {}
var anchors := {}
var jumped_this_air: bool = false
var air_ticks: int = 0
var land_ticks: int = 0
var was_on_floor: bool = true
var hosing: bool = false        # water is pouring (set by session)
var bag_in_flight: int = 0      # survivors still flying toward the bag (set by session); their heads appear on landing
var action_queue: Array = []    # timed poses that override movement, e.g. [["grab", 15], ["toss", 27]]
var action_cancel_on_move: bool = false

func _ready() -> void:
	name = "Player"
	collision_layer = 2
	collision_mask = 1
	floor_snap_length = 1.0
	var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
	shape.size = BOX
	var collider := CollisionShape2D.new()
	collider.shape = shape
	collider.position = Vector2(0, -BOX.y / 2.0)
	add_child(collider)
	var info: Dictionary = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(ART_DIR + "anchors.json"))
	anchors = info.anchors
	for state in anchors:
		textures[state] = load(ART_DIR + state + ".png")
	art = Node2D.new()
	art.show_behind_parent = true  # the code-drawn rescue bag stays on top of the art
	add_child(art)
	sprite = Sprite2D.new()
	sprite.centered = false
	art.add_child(sprite)
	show_pose("idle")

# Swap the state image. The anchor (bottom-center of the collision box in texture px)
# lands on the origin; the holder's negative x scale mirrors the art when facing left.
func show_pose(state: String) -> void:
	pose = state
	sprite.texture = textures[state]
	var a: Array = anchors[state]
	sprite.position = -Vector2(a[0], a[1])
	art.scale = Vector2(0.5 * facing, 0.5)
	queue_redraw()  # the bag follows the pose

# Timed state poses (grab, toss, respawn), played in order and held for their tick count.
func play_actions(steps: Array, cancel_on_move: bool = false) -> void:
	action_queue = steps.duplicate(true)
	action_cancel_on_move = cancel_on_move
	show_pose(action_queue[0][0])

func _update_pose() -> void:
	var on_floor := is_on_floor()
	if on_floor:
		if not was_on_floor and air_ticks > 10:
			land_ticks = LAND_TICKS
		air_ticks = 0
		jumped_this_air = false
	else:
		air_ticks += 1
	was_on_floor = on_floor
	if land_ticks > 0:
		land_ticks -= 1
	if not action_queue.is_empty() and action_cancel_on_move and (absf(velocity.x) > 8.0 or not on_floor):
		action_queue.clear()
	if not action_queue.is_empty():
		show_pose(action_queue[0][0])
		action_queue[0][1] -= 1
		if action_queue[0][1] <= 0:
			action_queue.pop_front()
	elif not on_floor:
		# A jump is one flying kick all the way; walking off a ledge is the meditating fall.
		show_pose("rising" if jumped_this_air else "falling")
	elif land_ticks > 0:
		show_pose("landing")
	elif absf(velocity.x) > 8.0:
		show_pose("run")
	elif hosing:
		show_pose("hose")
	else:
		show_pose("idle")

func reset_at(spawn: Vector2) -> void:
	position = spawn
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	last_floor_tick = -1000
	jump_request_tick = -1000
	opportunity_consumed = false
	require_jump_release = true
	test_jump_pressed = false
	jumps = 0
	rescued = 0
	bag_types.clear()
	jumped_this_air = false
	air_ticks = 0
	land_ticks = 0
	was_on_floor = true
	hosing = false
	bag_in_flight = 0
	play_actions([["respawn", 30]], true)  # snaps into the ready stance; any movement ends it
	queue_redraw()

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not enabled:
		return
	tick += 1
	var axis := test_axis if test_control else Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
	var held := test_jump_held if test_control else Input.is_action_pressed("jump")
	var pressed := test_jump_pressed if test_control else Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump")
	test_jump_pressed = false
	if not held:
		require_jump_release = false
	if is_on_floor() and velocity.y >= 0.0:
		last_floor_tick = tick
		opportunity_consumed = false
	if pressed and not require_jump_release:
		jump_request_tick = tick
	var rate: float = tuning.acceleration if not is_zero_approx(axis) else tuning.deceleration
	velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, axis * tuning.speed, rate * delta)
	if not is_zero_approx(axis):
		facing = signf(axis)
	velocity.y = minf(velocity.y + tuning.gravity * delta, tuning.terminal_velocity)
	if not opportunity_consumed and tick - last_floor_tick <= tuning.coyote_ticks and tick - jump_request_tick <= tuning.buffer_ticks:
		velocity.y = tuning.jump_velocity
		opportunity_consumed = true
		jump_request_tick = -1000
		jumps += 1
		jumped_this_air = true
		jumped.emit()
	move_and_slide()
	position.x = maxf(position.x, 10.0)
	_update_pose()
	queue_redraw()

func _draw() -> void:
	# The body is the generated art (sprite above). Only the rescue bag is still code-drawn:
	# the art has no bag, and rescued survivors ride in it (person or dog head per rescue).
	# Same drawing as Assignment 1, doubled, placed per pose on his back. Hidden until the
	# first rescue, so the empty bag doesn't cover the generated art.
	if bag_types.is_empty():
		return
	var f := facing                 # +1 right, -1 left
	var c: Vector2 = BAG.get(pose, BAG.idle)
	draw_set_transform(Vector2(c.x * f, c.y), 0.0, Vector2(2.0, 2.0))
	var ink := Color("1b2a3f")      # outline
	var skin := Color("e8b98f")     # face
	var bag_col := Color("e67e22")  # orange rescue duffel
	var bag_dark := Color("b8621b") # bag seam
	draw_rect(Rect2(-4.5, -4.5, 9, 9), ink)
	draw_rect(Rect2(-3.5, -3.5, 7, 7), bag_col)
	draw_rect(Rect2(-3.5, -3.5, 7, 2), bag_dark)
	# rescued survivors ride in the bag — a clear head per rescue (grows as you save more)
	for i in range(bag_types.size() - bag_in_flight):
		var hx := (-1.0 + float(i) * 4.5) * f
		var hyy := -7.0
		if String(bag_types[i]) == "dog":
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(hx-3, hyy-1), Vector2(hx-2, hyy-6), Vector2(hx+0.5, hyy-1)]), Color("6b4420"))  # left ear
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(hx+0.5, hyy-1), Vector2(hx+2, hyy-6), Vector2(hx+3, hyy-1)]), Color("6b4420"))  # right ear
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx, hyy), 3.2, Color("8a5a2b"))       # dog head
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx + 1.2 * f, hyy + 0.5), 0.9, ink)  # snout/eye
		else:
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx, hyy), 3.2, skin)                 # person head
			draw_rect(Rect2(hx - 3.0, hyy - 3.6, 6.0, 2.2), Color("3a2f1a"))  # hair
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx + 1.2 * f, hyy), 0.8, ink)        # eye

	await play_route()
	var bad := []
	for e in game.sfx_log:
		if e.state != expected[e.id]:

	await fresh()
	game.player.position = Vector2(330, 310)
	await steps(4)

	await steps(130)                       # the fire death retries by itself
	game.restart_attempt()                 # R-style retry

	await fresh()

	await fresh()
	for id in game.sfx_players:
		game.sfx_players[id].stream = null
	game.music.stream = null
	var route2 = Route.new()
	var ticks2 := 0
	while game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and ticks2 < 3000:
		route2.step(game.player)
		await physics_frame
		ticks2 += 1
	var silent := {"state": game.state, "ticks": ticks2, "deaths": game.deaths, "jumps": game.player.jumps, "rescued": game.rescued_count, "pos": str(game.player.position.round())}

	# 12. Music behaviour (CHANGE-BRIEF). Runs only when godot/audio/music_loop.ogg exists;
	#     otherwise it is reported as SKIPPED, not passed.
	await fresh()
	if game.music.stream == null:
		print(JSON.stringify({"id": "music-behaviour", "status": "SKIPPED", "observed": "no res://audio/music_loop.ogg yet"}))
	else:
		await steps(5)
		var playing: bool = game.music.playing and not game.music.stream_paused and game.music.volume_db == 0.0
		game.set_paused(true)
		await steps(3)
		var paused: bool = game.music.stream_paused
		game.set_paused(false)
		await steps(3)
		var pos_before: float = game.music.get_playback_position()
		game.player.position = Vector2(330, 310)
		await steps(4)
		var dipped: bool = game.state == Game.State.DYING and game.music.volume_db < -1.0 and game.music.playing
		await steps(130)
		var back: bool = game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.music.volume_db == 0.0 and game.music.get_playback_position() > pos_before
		game.resolve_contacts(false, true)
		await steps(3)
		var stopped: bool = not game.music.playing
		check("music-behaviour", playing and paused and dipped and back and stopped, {"playing": playing, "paused": paused, "dipped": dipped, "back_without_restart": back, "stopped_on_win": stopped})
		# The loop wraps: after one full length (25.6 s) it is back near the start and still playing.
		await fresh()
		var length: float = game.music.stream.get_length()
		var wrapped := false
		var last := 0.0
		var t2 := 0
		while t2 < int((length + 2.0) * 60.0) and game.state == Game.State.PLAYING:
			await physics_frame
			t2 += 1
			var pos: float = game.music.get_playback_position()
			if pos + 1.0 < last:
				wrapped = true
			last = pos
		check("music-loops", game.music.stream.loop and wrapped and game.music.playing, {"length_s": length, "loop": game.music.stream.loop, "wrapped": wrapped, "playing": game.music.playing})

	print("AUDIO TESTS: %d failures" % failures)
	game.queue_free()
	await process_frame
	quit(1 if failures else 0)

1	## A3 headless check of the three props in scenes3d/props_room.tscn.
2	##   timeout 120 godot --headless --path godot --script res://tests/check_props.gd --fixed-fps 60
3	##   ... -- mutate     (deliberately breaks the scene in memory: the check must then FAIL all three props)
4	## For each prop it prints, beside my brief (latest CHANGE-BRIEF revision, in Godot axes W x H x D):
5	##   - the GLOBAL bounding box (every MeshInstance3D's AABB pushed through its global transform,
6	##     so a rotated or scaled node cannot hide behind a correct-looking mesh),
7	##   - the scale of the prop node and of every mesh node under it,
8	##   - which world axis the prop's height lies along (Y = upright),
9	##   - the bottom of the prop compared with the floor's surface (sits on it / floats / sinks),
10	##   - the triangle count from the imported index buffers, against my budget.
11	## What it does NOT show: whether the props look right, read as a hydrant / backpack / flame,
12	## have the right colours, or suit the game's style. Those are my human checks.
13	extends SceneTree
14	
15	const TOL := 0.01  # metres
16	const PROPS := {
17		"Hydrant":   {"brief": Vector3(0.40, 0.80, 0.36),  "budget": 400},
18		"RescueBag": {"brief": Vector3(0.36, 0.612, 0.306), "budget": 300},
19		"Flame":     {"brief": Vector3(0.36, 0.62, 0.265),  "budget": 400},
20	}
21	
22	func _initialize() -> void:
23		var scene: Node3D = load("res://scenes3d/props_room.tscn").instantiate()
24		root.add_child(scene)
25		var mutate := "mutate" in OS.get_cmdline_user_args()
26		if mutate:
27			# Planted faults: the check must catch every one of them.
28			scene.get_node("Hydrant").rotate_z(PI / 2)            # lying on its side (prediction P1)
29			scene.get_node("RescueBag").scale = Vector3(2, 2, 2)  # scale not 1 (wrong size)
30			scene.get_node("Flame").position.y -= 0.2             # sunk into the floor (prediction P2)
31			print("MUTATE MODE: hydrant rotated 90 deg, bag scaled x2, flame lowered 0.2 m")
32		await process_frame
33	
34		var floor: MeshInstance3D = scene.get_node("Floor")
35		var floor_y: float = _global_aabb(floor).end.y   # the top of the floor plane (a flat plane: its top IS its surface)
36		print("Floor surface at y = %.4f (plane %s, its own scale %s)" % [floor_y, floor.mesh.size, floor.scale])
37	
38		var failures := 0
39		for name in PROPS:
40			var node: Node3D = scene.get_node(name)
41			var spec: Dictionary = PROPS[name]
42			var brief: Vector3 = spec.brief
43			var budget: int = spec.budget
44			var box := _global_aabb(node)
45			var size := box.size
46			var scales: Array = [node.scale]
47			var tris := 0
48			for mi in _meshes(node):
49				scales.append(mi.global_transform.basis.get_scale())
50				tris += _triangles(mi.mesh)
51			var all_one: bool = scales.all(func(s): return s.is_equal_approx(Vector3.ONE))
52			var tallest: String = "X" if size.x >= size.y and size.x >= size.z else ("Y" if size.y >= size.z else "Z")
53			var bottom_gap: float = box.position.y - floor_y
54			var on_floor: bool = absf(bottom_gap) <= TOL
55			var diff: Vector3 = (size - brief).abs()
56			var size_ok: bool = diff.x <= TOL and diff.y <= TOL and diff.z <= TOL
57			var upright: bool = tallest == "Y" and node.global_transform.basis.y.normalized().is_equal_approx(Vector3.UP)
58			var ok: bool = size_ok and all_one and upright and on_floor and tris <= budget
59			if not ok:
60				failures += 1
61			print("%-9s | size W×H×D %.3f × %.3f × %.3f m (brief %.3f × %.3f × %.3f) %s | scale %s | height along %s %s | bottom %+.4f m vs floor %s | tris %d / %d %s | %s" % [
62				name, size.x, size.y, size.z, brief.x, brief.y, brief.z, "ok" if size_ok else "OFF",
63				"1,1,1" if all_one else str(scales), tallest, "(upright)" if upright else "(NOT upright)",
64				bottom_gap, "on it" if on_floor else ("FLOATS" if bottom_gap > 0 else "SINKS"),
65				tris, budget, "ok" if tris <= budget else "OVER", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL"])
66		print("RESULT: %s (%d of %d props failing)%s" % ["PASS" if failures == 0 else "FAIL", failures, PROPS.size(), " [mutate mode]" if mutate else ""])
67		quit(1 if failures > 0 else 0)
68	
69	func _meshes(n: Node) -> Array:
70		var out: Array = []
71		if n is MeshInstance3D:
72			out.append(n)
73		for c in n.get_children():
74			out.append_array(_meshes(c))
75		return out
76	
77	func _global_aabb(n: Node) -> AABB:
78		var box := AABB()
79		var first := true
80		for mi in _meshes(n):
81			var a: AABB = mi.mesh.get_aabb()
82			for i in 8:
83				var p: Vector3 = mi.global_transform * a.get_endpoint(i)
84				if first:
85					box = AABB(p, Vector3.ZERO)
86					first = false
87				else:
88					box = box.expand(p)
89		return box
90	
91	func _triangles(mesh: Mesh) -> int:
92		var t := 0
93		for s in mesh.get_surface_count():
94			var arrays: Array = mesh.surface_get_arrays(s)
95			var idx = arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX]
96			t += (idx.size() if idx != null else arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX].size()) / 3
97		return t
